mentions.name: Grokbot
mentions.description: A team of AI employees shaped by the company's long-term org chart and culture, supported by purpose-built MCP tooling (such as MIS, mail, kanban, and ERP) so AI employees can work fully autonomously and operate independently; planned to be open sourced once things run smoothly.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m using my company’s long‑term org chart and culture to shape the Grokbot team, and building mcp (like MIS/mail/kanban/ERP) for them, so that AI employees can work fully autonomously and operate independently.
